versionFieldNote: allowlistVersion is machine-enforced: extraction/verify_all.py check 3 fails the run if tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json's own version drifts from this field. repositoryVersion and pageSpecVersion are documentation-only, hand-maintained markers with nothing checking them automatically.
structuralNotes: The source project's client-side router (src/router.js) intercepts and makes inert every link that does not resolve to one of its 8 real ROUTES — this is a deliberate 'no external requests / no outbound navigation' build constraint, not an oversight.

The ContactSales route (/contact/sales) is a deliberate, narrow exception: it embeds a real third-party Tally form widget (src/pages/ContactSales/TallyContactForm.jsx), which does submit outbound to a real third-party service. This is documented explicitly in sections/form.contact-sales.json's thirdPartyEmbed field.

This project's source (the original site) is a real, live, commercial company. Every asset role touching a real logo, a real named person's photo, or a real quote attributed to a real person carries explicit must-not-fabricate / must-reuse-exact licensing guidance in its owning section contract — see sections/social-proof.logo-wall.json, social-proof.testimonials.json, social-proof.tweet-wall.json, content.article-body.json, careers.jobs-page.json, integration.connector-strip.json, feature-grid.marketing.json, and social-proof.logo-marquee.json.

src/layout.json (found in the source project) is a stale first-draft artifact — it lists an older Home section list missing the Pricing section and uses mismatched component names versus the current src/pages/Home/index.jsx. It was not used as a build source; templates/templates.json was built directly from the real index.jsx files instead.
